name: odoo-ngocvietai
description: Connect Claude Code to the Odoo ERP at odoo.ngocvietai.com: search, read, aggregate, create and update records (partners, sales, invoices, CRM, inventory, projects) through Odoo's JSON-RPC API.

odoo_db.title: Odoo database
odoo_db.description: Database name on odoo.ngocvietai.com (Odoo 16 live: odoo)

odoo_username.title: Odoo login
odoo_username.description: Login email of the Odoo user the AI acts as (use a dedicated read-only AI user)

odoo_api_key.title: Odoo API key
odoo_api_key.description: Odoo → Preferences → Account Security → New API Key. Stored in Claude Code's secure credential storage.
